label: 水溶解度 logS
split_method: whole Bemis-Murcko scaffolds; all acyclic compounds share one group; seed42 largest-first
selection: minimum validation RMSE among three prespecified candidates, then refit train+validation
aggregation: Group by non-stereochemical canonical identity; median labels. For logS prefer AqSolDB if present; frozen ESOL test uses original v1 labels.
evaluation_note: Fixed internal scaffold holdout; not external validation. Empirical split-conformal intervals do not guarantee coverage under scaffold distribution shift. Metrics include all held-out rows, including OOD rows the app may withhold.
limitations: Conditions such as temperature, pH (except logD74 definition), solid form and protocols are incompletely represented.
Reference observations may disagree; local database preserves each source record.
Fingerprint similarity and descriptor bounds are heuristics, not proof of validity.
Calibration partitions and test partitions have distinct scaffolds; nominal 90% need not be achieved.

v1_same_test_comparison.note: Identical 224 ESOL labels; all matching test identities and scaffolds removed from AqSolDB/ESOL fit, validation and calibration.
